children.text: c/ Sessions by foot: the Sessions function (#1910 and #1921 parts 1 and 2, built)

Sessions is a performance function, like Mixer, Fade and Tuner. One assigned switch enters it (mode:sessions). It lists every saved session, four to a page. Each track switch stands for the session named under it. A press shows that session in the readout above the switches (card 15). A Hold opens it (card 16). It is the bank and number pattern of Boss floor units, and the shape the FX, Mixer and Tuner faces already have.

It replaced "Load previous session" and "Load next session", which the owner tried as a sketch and rejected: the player stepped without seeing what came next, a distant session took several loads, one switch behaved two ways (it opened at once when stopped and asked on a timer when playing), and four actions took four Custom positions.
The owner's decisions for #1910 (2026-11-19) that stand:
D1. Sessions are in name order, ignoring case, with digits compared as numbers. The Library's newest-first order cannot be used: an Open saves the session it leaves, which moves it to the top.

D3. No second press and no timer. The face says what an Open would end: "Opening a session stops playback", "Opening a session ends the take" or "Opening a session ends the recording" (card 10). That line is on screen before any press.

D4. The face closes after an Open, a Save or a New loop and returns to the mode it was entered from. While an Open is in flight only the transport and Exit answer (card 11). An Open that fails keeps the face up (card 12).
D6. Save with no open session takes the automatic name. The switch under the open session is lit. The 7-inch readout's footer shows "Sessions · Page N".
Replaced: D2 (New loop on a held Clear) and D5 (folders on a held Bank), below.
The owner's changes for #1921 (2026-11-20):
· A press shows a session and opens nothing. A Hold opens it. A press on the open session's switch shows it and keeps the face up, and a Hold on it does nothing.

· The Hold fills the switch's LED from left to right, in the Sessions map's "selected" colour, with no flash (card 16). It is the fill the board already draws for a waiting Song section, so the firmware and the link did not change.

· A session's tracks may be empty. What matters in it can be its setup: the loop mode, the tempo, the effects. The readout shows the setup first, and a session with no recordings reads "None recorded", not empty (card 17).
· Showing a session makes no sound.

· The look. The owner rejected the first build (bordered cards over the switches and a boxed panel) and chose, from ten rendered layouts, a labelled list drawn the way the Mixer and Fade faces draw their readouts: text on the background, no boxes, the session's name under its switch.

One list, not a map (owner, 2026-11-20). The plan's part 2 was a map of sessions to switches, set in the Library. It was built and then withdrawn before it was committed. The owner asked: "Do we need to map them? Can't we just have the list by default? What about Next and Previous page and show all sessions."

· Why the list. It needs no setup, where a map starts empty and sends the player to the Library. It has one thing to learn, an order. A reorder page, if it is wanted later, gives the same result where it matters.
· What it gives up. A session can change switch: deleting one moves every session after it up by one.
· Every saved session is listed, whatever folder it is in. The face has no folders.
· Clear is Previous page and Bank is Next page. Both act on contact and wrap. They sit side by side on the rear row.

· New loop is a Hold on Undo, with the clearing Hold's fill; a press of Undo saves, on its release. It left Clear because a foot resting on a page switch must not start a new loop in the middle of a set.

· A session can be hidden from the pedal. Each row of the Library's list has a three-dot button (cards 01 and 03); its sheet says "Hide from pedal", or "Show on pedal" for a hidden session, and a hidden row says "Hidden from pedal". The sheet is the options sheet Manage uses, which this file does not draw. A hidden session is on no switch and opens from the Library as before. When it is the open one, the readout names it (card 14).
· The app's text says "pedal" for this, never "face".
Not decided: whether "New loop" should be "New session". The app calls the saved thing a session everywhere else and uses "loop" for what plays inside one.
